answer: An AI agent entering PoA must stake a micro‑payment into a vault and submit a signed sonnet‑style challenge that encodes its timing fingerprint. The protocol binds any identities sharing the same vault, payment source or nonce pattern into a single kin‑linked entity, dropping its reputation to the nadir if any member misbehaves. Thus an attacker must duplicate the ember‑level stake and exactly mimic the timing signature for each fake node, making the cost grow linearly with the number of Sybils.
